they are not synthesized. native asset shape selected media is uploaded through: post /api/social/assets/:alias/upload returned manifests are preserved rather than collapsed. relevant fields include: id type mime size publicpath dimensions/duration where present title/alt/caption/role where available only /api/social/assets/ public paths are accepted by meta planning. publication actual content mutation occurs only through: post /api/social/unified social/publish the migration planner never calls a hidden publication route. the client replans after upload so rootassets contain real server issued paths before publication. idempotency and retries meta idempotency keys hash provider, source id, alias, heichel, and series. rerunning the same migration destination therefore produces the same key without leaking a long raw source id. checkpointed completed keys are skipped. failures remain retryable. rate pacing the upload api returns live rate evidence: remaining resetat the client waits only when remaining reaches zero and uses the returned reset boundary. it does not invent a separate rate schedule.
